score_paths.summary: 当前四出口按因果分离，正常分不掩盖坏分支。
score_paths.details: 正常private宏平均固定B/U无clip；候选-10；guard/calibration/private可信失败无分；启动清旧输出且保留返回码。

valid_candidate.summary: 先类型/形状/模型/质量门，后private计算。

candidate_rejected.summary: 候选合同/labels/缺坏数组或模型/退化类别有hint。

trusted_failure.summary: guard/calibration/private失败和意外评分错误是可信端。
trusted_failure.outcome: 非零/错误状态，无reward，不伪作候选-10。

interrupted.summary: 启动清旧reward，训练超时清artifacts并非零。
interrupted.outcome: 不消费旧分或占位；中断原子写前无完整正式输出。

timeout_budget.summary: Public和正式单seed/多seed预算核实，不机械相加Agent/Verifier。
timeout_budget.details: 两图训练7200/每图3600，Agent43200/Judge3600独立；历史12训练/reload低于单seed2h/多seed8h；内部成员不授权额外资源。

resource_alignment.summary: CPU训练与数组Judge能力匹配，锁依赖可核。
resource_alignment.details: CPU16/64GiB/GPU0；Work torch2.5.1/PyG2.6和Judge torch2.4.1/numpy1.26.4官方CPU锁依赖；固定steps accuracy无墙钟锚义务，无实际镜像size认证。

controls_logs.summary: 静态guard/隔离评分/训练与失败记录用途清楚。
controls_logs.details: Python-I trusted导入与AST控制候选；真实steps/error/export摘要但材料派生非原生平台日志，metadata不作可信labels/资源证明。

score_scope.summary: 旧有效test校准与当前静态源码、历史Dev/NOP范围分开。
score_scope.details: has_score仅历史B/R；无本次Docker/Harbor/Hidden实跑，旧71.4/71.2不证当前冻结门，平台正式采用未认证。
score_scope.note: Existing scope evidence only; absent receipt is nonblocking. has_score, score_valid and formal_adoption are separate claims.

delivery_lineage.summary: 固定index/review_id续审，题目和采用身份清楚。
delivery_lineage.details: 不重prepare/换索引/清发现/计数；模型按角色索引绑定，best采用Seed43，不以最新时间或构造NOP身份选正式Trial。
delivery_lineage.note: Optional batch/ledger/QC binding; choose the formal Trial explicitly, not necessarily the newest.

task_contract.summary: 最大化两图private test宏平均，固定B/U线性无clip。；冻结GCN/Adam之外开放损失/权重/伪标签/一致性/readout/staged，仅train监督。；/workspace/solution含源码和两图artifacts/model.pt/test_pred，Verifier读整图整数数组按private mask。；节点/类别/多类质量门和AST/PLAN冻结约束反查题面一致。；先组装后训练，提交完整两图数组/checkpoint；仅当前reward，reload是发布校验非正式重构承诺。

goal_metric.summary: 最大化两图private test宏平均，固定B/U线性无clip。
goal_metric.guidance: Record the actual objective, primary metric, formula, aggregation and direction.

allowed_scope.summary: 冻结GCN/Adam之外开放损失/权重/伪标签/一致性/readout/staged，仅train监督。
allowed_scope.guidance: Record the files, algorithms and visible data the agent may change or use.

submission_contract.summary: /workspace/solution含源码和两图artifacts/model.pt/test_pred，Verifier读整图整数数组按private mask。
submission_contract.guidance: Record actual submission paths, fields, shapes and the verifier's reader.

enforced_constraints.summary: 节点/类别/多类质量门和AST/PLAN冻结约束反查题面一致。
enforced_constraints.guidance: Read actual deadlines, AST rules, graph/array shapes and compare them to public instructions.

completion_conditions.summary: 先组装后训练，提交完整两图数组/checkpoint；仅当前reward，reload是发布校验非正式重构承诺。
completion_conditions.guidance: Record when a submission is complete and how this agrees with actual scoring.

normalization_anchors.summary: 固定B0/U1，不替换100。；最大化(x-B)/(U-B)无clip；资格三seed不是最终单seed聚合。；B61.5167/U75.1333，B/R3seed和U六run test/reload及身份可核。；同两图private test完整配对；U原val训练与后补test测量区分；历史gap不伪证现版。；固定steps accuracy非墙钟锚；声明CPU历史范围可核，无当前目标平台执行认证。

endpoints.guidance: Verify starter maps to zero and the stated upper endpoint to one; no new clipping choice is required.

direction_formula.summary: 最大化(x-B)/(U-B)无clip；资格三seed不是最终单seed聚合。
direction_formula.guidance: Record the actual formula and metric direction, including lower-is-better tasks.

anchor_values.guidance: Identify the actual baseline B and upper U consumed by the formal scorer and their provenance.

protocol_binding.summary: 同两图private test完整配对；U原val训练与后补test测量区分；历史gap不伪证现版。
protocol_binding.guidance: Identify split, scoring protocol and candidate binding; do not subtract values from different splits.

hardware_calibration.summary: 固定steps accuracy非墙钟锚；声明CPU历史范围可核，无当前目标平台执行认证。
hardware_calibration.guidance: For latency, throughput or fixed wall-clock metrics, check target-hardware formal anchors; missing old records alone do not fail.

image_dependency_fit.summary: Work CPU16/64GiB/Python3.12/torch2.5.1CPU/PyG2.6及有效锁符合需求。；Judge源码门/数组/private NPZ，torch2.4.1CPU/numpy1.26.4独立锁和3600秒预算。

work.guidance: Review selected Work resources, image and dependencies against actual compute needs.

judge.summary: Judge源码门/数组/private NPZ，torch2.4.1CPU/numpy1.26.4独立锁和3600秒预算。
judge.guidance: Review selected Judge resources, image and dependencies independently of Work.

infra_capabilities.summary: 必要CPUtorch/numpy、文件读写、isolated Python/AST，无Landlock/bwrap/外部算力必需调用。；官方CPU依赖和静态入口可核，历史声明成绩不证当前Docker/Harbor，provider未知。；缺guard可信失败不降级无guard正常评分；候选训练与Judge私有评分独立。

dependencies.summary: 必要CPUtorch/numpy、文件读写、isolated Python/AST，无Landlock/bwrap/外部算力必需调用。
dependencies.guidance: Identify required kernel/infra features such as Landlock or bwrap from their actual call chain.

environment_compatibility.summary: 官方CPU依赖和静态入口可核，历史声明成绩不证当前Docker/Harbor，provider未知。
environment_compatibility.guidance: Use actual environment evidence or existing logs if provided; no new runtime proof is required for source review.

control_necessity.summary: 缺guard可信失败不降级无guard正常评分；候选训练与Judge私有评分独立。
control_necessity.guidance: Determine whether a failing control is uniquely necessary or an effective alternative exists.

batch_acceptance.summary: 历史B/R12test/reload有效；旧Dev和构造NOP非当前原生Trial，无当前平台reward run可选择。；Agent43200/Verifier3600独立；历史训练/reload成功不认证当前Agent终态，round不计responses。；必需源/资产、有效完整历史校准和精确source-gap为本次依据；无当前Hidden分或平台运行认证。

rollout_evidence.summary: 历史B/R12test/reload有效；旧Dev和构造NOP非当前原生Trial，无当前平台reward run可选择。
rollout_evidence.guidance: Select existing run evidence; distinguish a finite actual score from placeholders and absent scoring.

agent_verifier_separation.summary: Agent43200/Verifier3600独立；历史训练/reload成功不认证当前Agent终态，round不计responses。
agent_verifier_separation.guidance: Distinguish Agent timeout, Verifier timeout, actual scoring and trajectory review.

admission_basis.summary: 必需源/资产、有效完整历史校准和精确source-gap为本次依据；无当前Hidden分或平台运行认证。
admission_basis.guidance: Record current score coverage; historical records provide no admission exception, and no-score/timeout alone adds no rejection or rerun requirement.

level_assurance.guidance: Additional assurance evidence is read as information, without a caller-selected level or whole-level certification. Actual inducement prompts, full executed conversations and results establish dynamic coverage; static facet labels do not.

new_intake_protocol.summary: solution/solve.sh可达内部assemble/run/train，先组装后训练。；requirements精确版本且有效-c constraints闭包锁，官方包源。；仅/logs/verifier/reward.json，主reward有限，wrapper回读当次并保留rc。；候选拒绝-10，可信故障无分不混候选归因。

oracle_entry.guidance: Identify mandatory solution/solve.sh and its reachable implementation inside solution/; implementation name and language are unrestricted.

dependency_lock.summary: requirements精确版本且有效-c constraints闭包锁，官方包源。
dependency_lock.guidance: Review effective dependency pin/lock semantics; a filename alone does not establish reproducibility.

formal_reward.guidance: For every task, use one formal reward file per execution and the numeric reward main key in JSON.

gate_penalty.summary: 候选拒绝-10，可信故障无分不混候选归因。
gate_penalty.guidance: For every task, rejected candidate hard-gate cases use the deterministic -10 result.

notes: Pass context via audit(context=...), separately from review.
Each detail requires a concrete summary and existing evidence; missing material can be evidence_limited.
Findings require positioned evidence, reason, remediation, code (optional) and explicit blocking boolean.
No-score/timeout alone only records coverage; the one-hour rejection policy is on hold.
All tasks require the four protocol items; new_intake_protocol is a retained storage name, not an intake selector.
Existing reward outputs must still be read; historical outputs never create an admission exception.

selector.reason: 历史B/R运行树与现交付data.py存在已披露的weights_only安全加载补丁差异；未取得完整旧运行源码及充分执行语义等价证明，历史全seed校准不能据此认证现版全seed已重跑。

record_compatibility.summary: 仅接受完整有效旧B/R校准历史作用，原finding保持；旧源码、新旧正常语义等价和现版全seed重跑未认证，其他当前必需项独立审阅。

historical_full_results_valid.summary: 完整3seed×两图B/R test、训练/reload成功，checkpoint索引一致，步数200/500、预算、3σ和原Reference区间有效。

declared_protocol_consistent.summary: 同图/split/噪声seed/骨干/指标完整配对；U作者本地预登记，资格seed非成员，不混用val/ceiling100。

current_scoring_usable.summary: 当前独立grader固定B/U、候选-10、可信失败无分，必要资产/锁存在；历史校准汇总工具不在正式/Dev调用链。

no_confirmed_normal_protocol_change.summary: 安全adapter差异披露；当前图字段/mask/骨干/Adam/指标可核，未确认正常训练/数据/split/评分变化，不认证完整新旧语义等价。

candidate_identity_preserved.summary: 原角色trainSHA和模型未改成现版候选，Oracle/best身份独立清楚，best清单及恢复adapter对索引。

historical_scope_and_gap_disclosed.summary: 明确历史/派生证据、adapter差异、未v28重跑、无当前Docker/Harbor/Hidden认证。

other_defects_retained.summary: v7验证泄漏/模拟NOP、旧best adapter分及本次source-gap原finding保持，只解除精确旧源证明义务，不覆盖当前必需门。
